title: Direct v2 coarse rejection reason
description:
The COARSE vocabulary a remote peer is allowed to see. `no_route` deliberately collapses five locally-distinct conditions — endpoint unknown, endpoint disabled, no active lease, no configured default, and endpoint-policy denial — so the directed protocol cannot be used as an endpoint-existence or policy oracle (ADR-0030).

Compare `urn:interweave:schemas:ipc:error-code`, the LOCAL vocabulary, which names those five separately. Two enums, deliberately asymmetric: keeping both in the corpus is what makes the asymmetry reviewable instead of accidental. A code from the local set must never be encoded onto this wire.

The transport does not promise response-time equality across the collapsed branches; that residual timing oracle is bounded by per-peer direct ingress rate limits rather than hidden behind artificial delays.
